nar.text: A short time before the start it stopped raining.
Nuvolari from the first row shot immediately into the lead, but Caracciola from the third row caught up with him as they passed the pits and led into the Südkurve.
Last to get away were the Auto Unions of Stuck and Pietsch which had both stalled on the grid.
Varzi in row five, accelerating through the oil smoke, heavy rain and water spray, just missed Stuck's stranded car but grazed the mechanic, who was knocked to the ground and lay there unconscious.

As his Mercedes went into the Karussell the left rear tire raptured. Von Brauchitsch had continued on the rim only to see the Alfa Romeo pass and win.
Nuvolari wins by 1m38.6s from Stuck; Caracciola third, Rosemeyer fourth, von Brauchitsch fifth.

Nuvolari was able to catch the German, passing him when one of von Brauchitsch's tyres blew out, and took the chequered flag to win the race in front of the stunned German High Command and 300,000 spectators.
